visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young girl with pigtails sitting on a patterned rug in a bright living room. She is wearing a brown and white striped long-sleeved shirt and cream-colored pants. A magnetic tangram book lies on the floor in front of her, and an adult's hand is visible nearby. The background features a wooden table, a massage chair, and a shelving unit. (2) The girl opens the tangram book, revealing colorful magnetic shapes and a yellow interior page. She looks focused as she begins to manipulate the shapes. The camera provides a close-up of her small hands moving a yellow triangle on the page. (3) The scene shifts to a closer view of the book as the girl successfully places a shape into a matching outline on an illustrated background. She smiles and looks up at the adult. The room is filled with soft, natural daylight. (4) The girl drops one of the magnetic pieces and humorously bends over, resting her forehead on the rug in a 'dramatic' gesture of frustration or fatigue. The adult's hand reaches in to retrieve the piece. (5) Back to the activity, the girl holds a red triangle and carefully considers where to place it. She touches her head with one hand as if thinking hard. She then successfully completes a shape of a rabbit on the illustrated page. (6) A final sequence shows a pink animation screen with a cartoon version of the girl holding a peach, with text appearing below her.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, upbeat acoustic guitar melody accompanying the voices of an adult female and a young child. The woman's voice is warm and encouraging, while the child responds with high-pitched, curious tones. (2) A subtle metallic click is heard each time a magnetic piece is placed on the book. As the girl succeeds, the adult reacts with an enthusiastic rising intonation, matched by a percussive 'ding' sound effect used for positive reinforcement. (3) When the child drops the piece, the vocal arousal levels increase as the adult makes a humorous remark about her being 'drama,' followed by soft laughter. (4) The BGM continues steadily as the child deliberates. The sound of her hand touching her head and moving shapes creates minor shuffling noises. (5) Upon completing the rabbit shape, there is a celebratory peak in the audio with higher vocal volume and a clear pop SFX, ending with a soft guitar fade-out as the animated screen appears.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to document and share a cute, educational parenting moment, showcasing the child's problem-solving skills and personality while playing with a tangram puzzle.
